candidate.linkType: known tunnel range -> verified enum 2; otherwise unknown
candidate.speedLimit: 0 follows inspected stock exporter; source limits retained separately

experimentalBenchProfile.otherUnknowns: remain JSON null; real ADAS acceptance of null primitives not established
experimentalBenchProfile.envelopeMetadata: explicit retained stock golden template, not inferred from Yandex
experimentalBenchProfile.selectionWire: Binder protobuf field1 struct, field3 int64 pathIDReq
experimentalBenchProfile.dynamicMissingPolicy: omit unavailable fields and retain missingAttributes; proto3 defaults are not known values
experimentalBenchProfile.locationProvenance: protocol GPS coordinate slots use Guidance ClassifiedLocation.getLocation; independent raw GNSS not established; matched slots use separate source-route interpolation

guard.legacyCapturePolicy: missing source session/position owner allowed only as labelled archival diagnostic compatibility
guard.restart: new sourceSessionId may reset generation/sequence; retired sessions rejected
guard.recovery: cached bytes retransmit, new local publication epoch, new labelled mock ACK
guard.realAckLimitation: ADAS ACK has no publication epoch token
guard.emulatorWatcher: explicit emulator-N serial plus qemu=1; allowlisted reads and bounded subprocess deadlines only
